rv.q: More a muddle than a triumph, it may prove a confusing introduction to Shakespeare; but it’s a visually memorable one nonetheless.
Lend your ears to Julius Caesar Remixed, a worthy 90 minutes of inspiring, entertaining and relevant theatre.

It’s abundantly clear that Intermission Youth’s production is ripe with talent and its newest production does not sacrifice the time-tested themes of Shakespeare, skilfully reducing the intimidation factor.

cn.t: Mixed reception: bold reimaginings impress visually with strong performances, but concepts feel dated. One urban remix earns praise for freshness; the all-female prison revival, once groundbreaking, struggles to recapture its original impact.
